record.paper_title: Quasiwypukłość i otwarte problemy analizy funkcjonalnej
record.original_question: Let S be the Ahlfors-Beurling transform, characterized here by the property that for a smooth compactly supported complex-valued function f, S applied to the anti-holomorphic derivative of f equals the holomorphic derivative of f. What is the best constant A_p in the L^p inequality ||S omega||_p <= A_p ||omega||_p?

evidence.quote: Pytanie o najlepszą stałą w nierówności kSωkp ¬ Ap kωkp jest jednym z fundamentalnych otwartych pytań w teorii przekształceń quasikonforemnych.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $S$ denote the Ahlfors–Beurling transform on the complex plane, that is, the singular integral operator on $L^p(\mathbb{C})$ ($1 < p < \infty$) defined (for sufficiently nice functions $\omega$) by the principal-value integral
$$ (S\omega)(z) \;=\; -\frac{1}{\pi}\,\mathrm{p.v.}\!\int_{\mathbb{C}} \frac{\omega(\zeta)}{(z-\zeta)^2}\, dA(\zeta), $$
where $dA$ is two-dimensional Lebesgue measure. Equivalently, for every smooth, compactly supported complex-valued function $f:\mathbb{C}\to\mathbb{C}$ one has $S(\bar{\partial} f) = \partial f$, where $\partial = \tfrac{1}{2}(\partial_x - i\partial_y)$ and $\bar{\partial} = \tfrac{1}{2}(\partial_x + i\partial_y)$.

For $1 < p < \infty$, define
$$ A_p \;=\; \|S\|_{L^p(\mathbb{C}) \to L^p(\mathbb{C})} \;=\; \sup\bigl\{\|S\omega\|_p : \omega \in L^p(\mathbb{C}),\ \|\omega\|_p \le 1\bigr\}. $$

Determine the exact value of $A_p$ for every $p \in (1,\infty)$. In particular, prove or disprove the conjectured identity
$$ A_p \;=\; p^{*} - 1, \qquad \text{where } p^{*} = \max\{p,\, p/(p-1)\}. $$
artifact.status_search_result: The exact $L^p$ operator norm of the Beurling–Ahlfors transform (Iwaniec's conjecture $A_p = p^*-1$) remains a well-known open problem. Substantial partial results provide upper bounds, e.g. Bañuelos–Wang $\le 4(p^*-1)$, Nazarov–Volberg $\le 2(p^*-1)$, with subsequent refinements (e.g. $\le 1.575(p^*-1)$), but the sharp constant has not been established for general $p \ne 2$.

status_evidence.title: Iwaniec's Conjecture on the Beurling-Ahlfors Transform (thesis)
status_evidence.snippet: Iwaniec's conjecture states that the Lp norm of the Beurling-Ahlfors transform equals p*-1; the conjecture is still open.
status_evidence.claim: The conjecture A_p = p*-1 is still open.

status_evidence.title: Lp-Bounds for the Beurling-Ahlfors transform (Bañuelos–Méndez-Hernández)
status_evidence.snippet: Upper bounds of the form C(p*-1) have been proved, but the sharp constant conjectured by Iwaniec remains unknown.
status_evidence.claim: Only upper bounds with constants larger than 1 are known.

status_evidence.title: arXiv:2109.04555 on Beurling-Ahlfors transform
status_evidence.snippet: Recent work continues to study the Iwaniec conjecture on the Lp norm of the Beurling-Ahlfors transform.
status_evidence.claim: Conjecture is still under active study.
